# scripts/Interaction/Loot.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../scripts/Interaction/Loot.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Frobbable rigid pickup transferring value to player.inventory.purse once.
It cannot be carried; successful frob marks taken and queues the body for deletion.

Base: `RigidBody3D`. Registered class: `Loot`.
